stagnant oxbow lakes with vibrant green algae visible under sunlight

layer_3_action.action: A wide, eye-level view of a sun-drenched estuarine environment, where sparkling water features wind through brightly lit, fertile plains covered in a variety of low-lying Mesozoic plants (no grass) under a clear, open sky.

visuals.ground: Brightly lit, dark peaty clay and sticky black mud, with abundant, vibrant green club mosses and ferns. Absolutely no grass.
visuals.water: Clear, sparkling brackish water in meandering channels and still oxbows, reflecting the bright blue sky.
visuals.sky: Vibrant, clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds, bright mid-day sun, with any coastal haze pushed to the distant horizon.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Wet, but sunlit and clearly textured mud, with vivid green club mosses and fern fronds dominating the ground cover. No grass.
